item.description:
Nexa 1.0.3

  • Chats recover on their own after messages go missing: if the relays lose up to 15 messages in a row from one person, Nexa still finds the ones that come after them. Before, losing 6 in a row could leave one side of a chat silent for good.
  • Group posts no longer go missing when a group's new key arrives later than a newer one.
  • A group's creator can invite someone again if the first invitation was lost.
  • An old "left" or "declined" message that arrives late no longer cancels someone's new membership or invitation.

Found by new long-running automated tests that play out thousands of conversations with lost, delayed and reordered messages.
